record.title: Prepare the RF evaluation gate from verified physical software state
record.intent: Complete Stage4 and make Stage5 reviewable without claiming or measuring analog performance.
requirements: Reconcile physical baseline, ten-option persistence, original signed APK and actual derived18/18 startup evidence; keep stock and derived originals and rollback procedure available.

Prepare a source-grounded RF comparison plan with equipment and path characterization, single-channel conditions, stock/derived/rollback comparison, uncertainty and decision criteria. Record missing bench inputs explicitly.
Do not apply RF, connect probes or USB, run calibration or claim measured1GHz performance. Commit and push conclusions and leave the checkout clean for operator evaluation.
acceptance: Stage4 is complete and Stage5 is ready for operator evaluation.
